boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Moravian University
boards.description: Current late-night destinations in Bethlehem, including campus spaces and food counters with publicly posted hours.

cards.title: Haupert Union Building
cards.subtitle: Moravian University Main Street Campus, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Use the HUB for a campus-based evening stop; check its event calendar and building access before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Moravian’s campus union stays open through 11 p.m. most nights and midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian lists HUB academic-year hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Mon–Thu 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri 6 a.m.–midnight; Sat 7 a.m.–midnight; Sun 8 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Reeves Library
cards.subtitle: Moravian University Main Street Campus, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Plan a focused study stop during the regular academic year, and confirm holiday, break, and summer changes first.
cards.short_summary: A campus study destination with published midnight closing on several regular-term nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Moravian’s Student Affairs handbook lists Reeves Library open until midnight Sunday and Monday through Thursday during the regular academic year.
cards.access_notes: Regular academic-year hours listed: Sun 1 p.m.–midnight; Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–midnight. The handbook says hours can change for breaks, holidays, and summer.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Fourth Street
cards.subtitle: 1620 East Fourth Street, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when dining room service has ended; review the location page for the nightly schedule before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Bethlehem Taco Bell location with drive-thru service posted until 1 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–1 a.m. every day for its 1620 East Fourth Street Bethlehem location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell, 1620 East Fourth Street | Official location page
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours are 9 a.m.–1 a.m. daily; posted dine-in hours end earlier, at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Easton Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2585 Easton Avenue, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru for the late window and check the store page on the day of your visit for any changes.
cards.short_summary: A second Bethlehem Taco Bell with a separately listed late drive-thru schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–1 a.m. every day for its 2585 Easton Avenue Bethlehem location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell, 2585 Easton Avenue | Official location page
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours are 9 a.m.–1 a.m. daily; posted dine-in hours end earlier, at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Easton Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1314 Easton Avenue, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to select carryout or delivery, then verify the midnight closing shown for this location.
cards.short_summary: This Pizza Hut’s official Bethlehem listing posts service until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s Bethlehem location page lists the 1314 Easton Avenue restaurant as open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery & Carryout in Bethlehem, PA | Pizza Hut
cards.access_notes: The official location listing identifies 1314 Easton Ave and says it is open until midnight; confirm ordering availability before departing.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Broadway Street
cards.subtitle: 308 Broadway Street, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Check the location page’s day-specific listing, then use the posted late closing window for a food pickup or drive-thru stop.
cards.short_summary: A South Bethlehem Wendy’s location whose official listing includes a 2 a.m. closing day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Bethlehem directory lists its 308 Broadway Street location and shows one day open until 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official directory lists 308 Broadway St and shows a day-specific closing time of 2 a.m.; verify the current day’s hours before going.

cards.title: Haaz’s Bethlehem
cards.subtitle: 3217 Schoenersville Road, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Place a pickup order through the restaurant’s official ordering page and use the posted weekend window when it applies.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual Bethlehem restaurant with official ordering hours extending to 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Haaz’s official Toast page lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 10 a.m.–midnight Sun–Thu and 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Fri–Sat.

cards.title: The Market Gourmet Express
cards.subtitle: Wind Creek Outlets, 77 Wind Creek Boulevard, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Enter through the Outlets or hotel as directed for minors, then check the listed counter hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: An outlet-area food hall with several counters open late, including some with 24-hour schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Wind Creek says minors may dine at The Market when entering through The Outlets or hotel, and lists late and 24-hour counter schedules.
cards.source_title: The Market Gourmet Express | Wind Creek Bethlehem
cards.access_notes: Minors are directed to enter through The Outlets or hotel. The page lists South Philly Steaks & Fries as open 24 hours Wed–Sun and other late counters.

cards.title: Mo’ Burger at The Market
cards.subtitle: Wind Creek Outlets, 77 Wind Creek Boulevard, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Enter through the Outlets or hotel if under 21, and confirm whether the late Friday–Saturday counter schedule is in effect.
cards.short_summary: A Market counter with posted service to 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wind Creek lists Mo’ Burger at The Market open 7 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 7 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Market Gourmet Express | Wind Creek Bethlehem
cards.access_notes: For minors, Wind Creek directs entry through The Outlets or hotel. Mo’ Burger’s listed late window is Fri–Sat until 2 a.m.

cards.title: South Philly Steaks & Fries at The Market
cards.subtitle: Wind Creek Outlets, 77 Wind Creek Boulevard, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Use the outlet or hotel entry route for minors and confirm the weekday schedule before relying on the overnight counter.
cards.short_summary: A Market counter with official 24-hour service posted from Wednesday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wind Creek lists South Philly Steaks & Fries at The Market open 10 a.m.–midnight Monday–Tuesday and 24 hours Wednesday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: The Market Gourmet Express | Wind Creek Bethlehem
cards.access_notes: For minors, Wind Creek directs entry through The Outlets or hotel. South Philly Steaks & Fries is listed open 24 hours Wed–Sun.
